chapters.text: Build a show from scenes, live sources and overlays. Single-canvas edits go straight to output.
Enable Studio mode: prepare the next scene in Preview while Program stays live.
Fade takes the prepared scene to Program.
Record Program independently using the same composed scene.
Private break replaces Program with a slate while recording continues.
Resume the show, then stop recording to finalize the file.
Scenes, sources and the saved show remain ready for the next production.
